name: brolly-guard
description: Self-hosted Cloudflare cost sentinel and emergency control plane

scripts.deploy: npm run db:migrate:remote && node scripts/deploy-guard.mjs wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.jsonc

DB.description: Brolly's private D1 database for policies, encrypted credentials, incidents, and audit history. Cloudflare provisions it automatically.
